# Glimpse

> Glimpse is a polished desktop shell toolkit for Niri on Wayland: panel,
> idle, lock screen, wallpaper, and sunset daemons. Extension authors can
> add panel widgets via `command` (declarative launchers) or `exec`
> (long-running child processes that speak a line protocol).

The pages below are LLM-optimized: single-file, self-contained references
that include every option, every JSON payload shape, and complete worked
examples in TOML, shell, Python, TypeScript, Rust, and Go.

## Extension References

- [Command Applet — Full Reference](https://alex-oleshkevich.github.io/glimpse/llms/command): TOML-only launcher buttons and right-click menus. No script, no protocol.
- [Exec Applet — Full Reference](https://alex-oleshkevich.github.io/glimpse/llms/exec): Long-running child processes driving panel status and popovers over a line protocol. Includes the protocol, every component type, every event, plus SDK starters for Python, TypeScript, Rust, and Go.

## Human Documentation

- [Glimpse Home](https://alex-oleshkevich.github.io/glimpse/): Overview, installation, configuration, theming.
- [Applet Reference](https://alex-oleshkevich.github.io/glimpse/applets/): Built-in applets (clock, battery, network, etc.).
- [Custom Applets Overview](https://alex-oleshkevich.github.io/glimpse/custom-applets/): Choosing between `command` and `exec`.
